description: This source file defines the HttpService class, which provides methods for performing HTTP operations (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) asynchronously with serialization and error handling support in a Blazor application.

classes.name: HttpService
classes.description: A service class that manages HTTP requests, including GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE, with response deserialization and error handling, tailored for use in a Blazor application.

methods.name: HttpGet
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request asynchronously to retrieve data of type T from a specified URI.

methods.name: HttpDelete
methods.description: Performs an HTTP DELETE request asynchronously to delete an entity identified by 'id' at a specified URI.

methods.name: HttpPost
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request asynchronously to send data to a server and retrieve a response of type T, with error handling that includes displaying toast notifications.

methods.name: HttpPut
methods.description: Performs an HTTP PUT request asynchronously to update data on a server and retrieve a response of type T, with error notification.

methods.name: ToJson
methods.description: Serializes an object to a JSON StringContent for HTTP payload.

methods.name: FromHttpResponseMessage
methods.description: Deserializes the JSON content from an HttpResponseMessage into an object of type T.

search-terms: JSON serialization GET POST PUT DELETE
